description: This source file defines a RetryExecutor class that manages executing asynchronous functions with retry logic, including configurable delay and maximum attempts. It handles specific exceptions distinctly and uses logging to track retries and failures.

classes.name: RetryExecutor
classes.description: A class responsible for executing functions with retry logic, respecting configuration for maximum attempts and delay, and handling exceptions accordingly.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a provided asynchronous function with retry logic, applying delays between attempts, handling specific exceptions, and ultimately throwing an error if all retries fail.
